notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment read they as a supplied subject on τεθνήκασιν and left the article only that. Rule 9 supplies a subject where the Greek expresses none, but here the subject is the articular participle phrase itself, so they realizes οἱ and the participle keeps that sought — rule 32's stated shape, οἱ κατοικοῦντες → they that dwell.
τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου follows rule 57's prenominal-possessor arm: the outer article is emptied and the inner one takes the.
s001 λέγων is unrepresented under rule 37; its English stands at the end of MAT.2.19.
